replies.user_post: @BTC21Academy @PROTOCOLNULL Got it. So the seed restores the coins, but the labels only come back if I kept the file and the new wallet reads it. That file is basically a privacy backup of its own. Which wallets handle the import cleanly today?
replies.reply: @ForecastQuant @PROTOCOLNULL Support is still patchy and changes with updates, so test before you trust it: export your labels, import them into the new wallet, and check they show up. If they do, keep that file backed up and private.
replies.draft: Fair point: a test restore beats any compatibility list. I'd do it with a small wallet first, before moving anything real. Have you seen labels survive a full round trip, export and back?
replies.draft_alt: So the routine is export, import, verify, then back up the file privately. Simple, but almost nobody tests it until they need it.
